profile.headline: Full Stack Cloud Engineer | Java, Angular, AWS-Certified| Cloud Migration | Remote Work Advocate
profile.summary:
Since completing my graduate degree, I’ve had the rare opportunity to perform opera around the world — an experience that taught me how to adapt quickly, work under pressure, and collaborate deeply with teams of highly skilled professionals. Whether on stage with fellow musicians or behind the scenes with directors and technical staff, I learned that great outcomes depend on great teamwork.

That same drive to challenge myself and keep learning has led me through several careers — from managing flight operations at Korean Air to working as a licensed real estate agent — and ultimately to the world of software development. I completed Tech Elevator’s Java bootcamp and have since been working as a Full Stack Software Developer at FedPoint.

At FedPoint, I lead Angular development on enterprise applications, support AWS cloud migrations, and build scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot. I’ve integrated AWS S3 and SES for secure file and email operations, and I continuously seek opportunities to mentor teammates and improve our codebase.

Today, I’m passionate about solving real-world problems through technology and always striving to grow. I recently completed the AWS Solutions Architect course and am actively working toward certification. I’m especially interested in remote-first teams where I can keep building innovative tools and collaborate with great people.

Let’s connect — I’m always open to learning from others and exploring new opportunities.
